cards.ex: I deeply regret my thoughtless remarks at the meeting; I didn't mean to offend anyone.
cards.exUz: Yig'ilishda o'ylamay aytgan gaplarimdan juda afsusdaman; hech kimni xafa qilmoqchi emasdim.
cards.uzDef: Chin dildan afsuslanish, qattiq pushaymon bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company offered redress to the affected customers after the data breach.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ma'lumotlarning buzilishi natijasida jabrlangan mijozlarga tovon puli taklif qildi.
cards.uzDef: Zararni qoplash uchun biror narsa taklif qilish.

cards.ex: He sought absolution for his past mistakes, hoping to start fresh.
cards.exUz: U o'tmishdagi xatolari uchun kechirim so'radi va yangidan boshlashga umid qildi.
cards.uzDef: Gunohlari uchun kechirilishni so'rash, afv etilishni istash.

cards.ex: It was just a slip-up; I didn't mean to reveal your secret.
cards.exUz: Bu shunchaki xato edi; men siringizni oshkor qilmoqchi emasdim.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmagan, ahamiyatsiz xato.

cards.ex: The investigation showed that the driver was at fault for the accident.
cards.exUz: Tekshiruv shuni ko'rsatdiki, haydovchi baxtsiz hodisada aybdor edi.
cards.uzDef: Xatoda yoki muammoda aybdor bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's important to own up to your mistakes and learn from them.
cards.exUz: Xatolaringizni tan olish va ulardan saboq olish muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Xato yoki noto'g'ri ishi uchun javobgarlikni tan olish.

cards.ex: It was a lapse in judgment, and I deeply regret my actions.
cards.exUz: Bu fikriy xato edi va men qilgan ishlarimdan juda afsusdaman.
cards.uzDef: O'ylamasdan qilingan xato, aqlsiz qaror.

cards.ex: He wants to make amends for the way he treated her in the past.
cards.exUz: U o'tmishda unga qilgan munosabatini qoplashni xohlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Xatoni yoki zararni tuzatishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: After many years, he hoped to be forgiven for his betrayal.
cards.exUz: Ko'p yillardan so'ng, u xiyonati uchun kechirilishiga umid qildi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning xatosini unutib, uni kechirish.

cards.ex: I know we've had our differences, but let bygones be bygones.
cards.exUz: Bilasiz, bizning kelishmovchiliklarimiz bo'lgan, lekin o'tgan ishlar o'tib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi narsalarni unutish va kechirish kerak.

cards.ex: Leaders must take responsibility for their decisions, even when they're unpopular.
cards.exUz: Rahbarlar qarorlari uchun, hatto ular mashhur bo'lmasa ham, javobgar bo'lishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan ishlaringiz uchun javobgar bo'lish.

cards.ex: The governor granted a pardon to the wrongly convicted man.
cards.exUz: Gubernator noto'g'ri hukm qilingan odamga afv berdi.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy ravishda kechirish, ayniqsa qonuniy sohada.

cards.ex: The newspaper offered a retraction after publishing inaccurate information.
cards.exUz: Gazeta noto'g'ri ma'lumotni chop etgandan so'ng, rad etish taklif qildi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri aytilgan gapni rasman qaytarib olmoq.

cards.ex: He expressed contrition for his actions and promised to do better.
cards.exUz: U qilgan ishlaridan pushaymonligini bildirdi va yaxshiroq ishlashga va'da berdi.
cards.uzDef: Xato qilganingizdan qattiq afsuslanganingizni bildirish.

cards.ex: After the argument, they both sought reconciliation and understanding.
cards.exUz: Janjaldan so'ng, ularning ikkalasi ham yarashish va tushunishga harakat qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Munosabatlarni tiklashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The court ordered him to make restitution to the victims of his fraud.
cards.exUz: Sud uni firibgarlik qurbonlariga tovon puli to'lashga majbur qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan zararni qoplash, ayniqsa moliyaviy.

cards.ex: I err on the side of caution and triple-check my work before submitting it.
cards.exUz: Men ehtiyotkorlik tomoniga adashaman va ishni topshirishdan oldin uch marta tekshiraman.
cards.uzDef: Xavfni kamaytirish maqsadida xato qilish.

cards.ex: Words can offer solace in times of grief, but actions speak louder.
cards.exUz: So'zlar qayg'u vaqtlarida tasalli berishi mumkin, lekin harakatlar balandroq gapiradi.
cards.uzDef: Qayg'uli odamga taskin berishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: It's time to bury the past and focus on building a better future.
cards.exUz: O'tmishni ko'mish va yaxshiroq kelajak qurishga e'tibor qaratish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi muammolarni unutish va davom etish.

cards.ex: She still bears a grudge against her former friend for betraying her trust.
cards.exUz: U hali ham sobiq do'stiga ishonchini xiyonat qilgani uchun xafalik saqlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir xafa bo'lish va uni kechirmaslik.

cards.ex: I hope you didn't take it amiss when I pointed out the error.
cards.exUz: Xatoni ko'rsatganimda xafa bo'lmadingiz degan umiddaman.
cards.uzDef: Aytilgan yoki qilingan narsadan xafa bo'lish.

cards.ex: I beg your pardon, I didn't realize I was standing in your way.
cards.exUz: Kechirasiz, men yo'lingizda turganimni sezmadim.
cards.uzDef: Xatosi uchun rasmiy ravishda kechirim so'rash.

cards.ex: The report tried to gloss over the company's financial difficulties.
cards.exUz: Hisobot kompaniyaning moliyaviy qiyinchiliklarini yashirishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Xatoni yoki muammoni yashirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He was truly contrite after realizing the damage he had caused.
cards.exUz: U o'zi keltirgan zararni anglaganidan so'ng chin dildan pushaymon bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Xato uchun juda afsusda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Sometimes, you have to let things slide for the sake of peace.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan, tinchlik uchun narsalarga e'tibor bermaslik kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoga e'tibor bermaslik yoki unga qarshi hech narsa qilmaslik.

cards.ex: The CEO issued a mea culpa for the company's ethical failures.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor kompaniyaning axloqiy xatolari uchun aybdorlikni e'lon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Aybdorligini tan olish.

cards.ex: I'm sorry for yelling; I'll make amends by cooking dinner tonight.
cards.exUz: Baqirganim uchun kechirasiz; kechki ovqatni tayyorlab tuzataman.
cards.uzDef: Yomon ish uchun yaxshi ish qilib, xatoni tuzatish.

cards.ex: It's hard to forgive oneself, but it's necessary for healing.
cards.exUz: O'zini kechirish qiyin, lekin tuzalish uchun zarur.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatolarini qabul qilib, o'zini kechirish.

cards.ex: He showed genuine remorse for his actions and sought forgiveness.
cards.exUz: U o'z harakatlaridan chin dildan pushaymon bo'ldi va kechirim so'radi.
cards.uzDef: Xato qilganidan afsusda ekanligini ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: He accepted the blame for the project's failure, even though others were involved.
cards.exUz: U loyihaning muvaffaqiyatsizligi uchun aybdorlikni qabul qildi, garchi boshqalar ham ishtirok etgan bo'lsa ham.
cards.uzDef: Xatosi uchun javobgarlikni qabul qilish.
